global_summary: This is a Business News program covering electric vehicle technology, infrastructure, and environmental benefits in Korea. The video begins with anchor segments about electric cars making the earth greener, then transitions to coverage of the EV KOREA 2012 exhibition. Key segments include interviews with Kia representatives demonstrating EV charging, Yoo Dong-kun from Korea Environment Corporation discussing plans to expand charging infrastructure from 500 to 2,600 stations, and Kim Tae-hoon explaining the business fair's purpose of facilitating professional exchanges in the EV industry. The program also features demonstrations of OLEV bus technology, sensor technologies, and various EV models on display at the exhibition.
